article.title: Maryland visits UConn in Week 2
article.story: Maryland (1-0) at UConn (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Maryland by 12.5. Against the spread: Maryland 1-0, UConn 1-0. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats Maryland Offense Overall: 646 yards per game (8th in FBS) Passing: 281 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 365 yards per game (5th) Scoring: 62 points per game (11th) Maryland Defense Overall: 85 yards per game (3rd in FBS) Passing: 75 yards per game (9th) Rushing: 10 yards per game (6th) Scoring: 0 points per game (1st) UConn Offense Overall: 671 yards per game (3rd in FBS) Passing: 370 yards per game (13th) Rushing: 301 yards per game (15th) Scoring: 56 points per game (19th) UConn Defense Overall: 209 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 145 yards per game (50th) Rushing: 64 yards per game (34th) Scoring: 7 points per game (25th) UConn is 111th in the FBS with a -2 turnover margin, compared to Maryland's 6th-ranked +3 margin. UConn is 138th in the FBS with 134 penalty yards per game. Maryland is 69th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 90% of trips. UConn's red zone defense ranks 10th at 50%. Team leaders Maryland Passing: Malik Washington, 186 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 61.3 completion percentage Rushing: DeJuan Williams, 116 yards on 3 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Na'eem Abdul-Rahim Gladding, 57 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD UConn Passing: Kalieb Osborne, 265 yards, 2 TDs, 1 INT, 73.1 completion percentage Rushing: Osborne, 90 yards on 8 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Javon Brown, 92 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD Last game Maryland won 62-0 over Hampton on Sept. 5. Washington threw for 186 yards on 19-of-31 attempts (61.3%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Williams had 116 rushing yards on three carries and two touchdowns, adding two receptions for 35 yards. Gladding put up 57 yards on six catches with one touchdown. UConn defeated Lafayette 56-7 on Sept. 5. Osborne threw for 265 yards on 19-of-26 attempts (73.1%) with two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball eight times for 90 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Trey Cornist had 76 rushing yards on six carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for four yards. Brown had six receptions for 92 yards and one touchdown. Next game Maryland hosts Virginia Tech on Sept. 19. UConn plays at Southern Miss on Sept. 19.
